versos.e: .Sprinkled on altar and people Ex 24:6-8; Eze 43:18,20
.Blood of the ram of consecration put on the tip of right ear, thumb, and big toe of, and sprinkled upon, Aaron and his sons Ex 29:2,21; Le 8:23,24,30
.Of the bullock of sin offering, put on the horns of the altar Ex 29:12; Le 8:15
.Poured at the bottom of the altar Ex 29:12; Le 8:15
.OF BURNT OFFERING Sprinkled all around, and upon the altar Ex 29:16; Le 1:5,11,15; 8:19; De 12:27
OF SACRIFICES, TYPICAL OF THE ATONING BLOOD OF CHRIST Heb 9:6-28
.OF PEACE OFFERING Sprinkled about the altar Le 3:2,8,13; 9:18

.OF SIN OFFERING Sprinkled seven times before the curtain Le 4:5,6,17 On the horns of the altar of sweet incense, and at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering Ex 30:10; Le 4:7,18,25,30; 5:9; 9:9,12
.OF TRESPASS OFFERING Sprinkled on the altar Le 7:2
.OF ATONEMENT Sprinkled on the mercy seat Le 16:14,15,18,19,27; 17:11
